notes.title: Update 29/25

* Fixed the save game system not loading.

* Minor fixes to the street lighting system.

notes.title: Update 28/25
notes.content:
* Major fixes to the services offered by the Concreteiro company. You can find this company in the city of Professor Souza.
[img]https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GsDMv7lsfVcVVJhi9S6MFX5fHwiPXJuM/view?usp=sharing[/img]
* Fixed ambient sounds becoming louder when the player bends down or climbs into bed.
* Fixed a crash when displaying interaction images when the player reaches for the fuel pump nozzle at the gas station.
* Fixed the TV screen appearing on even when it's off.
* Fixed a crash when trying to place a full gas cylinder on the stove.
* Note: If the MB 1313 has the ignition lever pressed down, the choke does not work.
* Improved ambient lighting.
* It is now possible to open the menu even while sitting in vehicles. Attention! Avoid saving the game while inside vehicles.
* Add light inside the room at the Concreteiro store.
* Add number 123 to the Constru Casa store on Rodolfo Motta Street in Casimiro de Abreu.
* Warning! If the save is corrupted, it will be automatically deleted.
* To open the grocery bag, you now use Y.
* When the player picks up objects, their position is based on the currently active camera.
* To rotate objects you can pick up, use:
Q or Shift + Q.
E or Shift + E.

notes.title: Update 27/25
notes.content:
* Added the option to change the field of view.
* There is no need to disable your controls when switching between automatic and manual transmission.
* Fixed the turbo needle rotating incorrectly.
* When opening the menu, the player cannot interact with objects.
* Added a FUEL LEAK effect when driving the vehicle with the gas cap open.
* The player shrinks in size when climbing into bed.
* An image of the F key appears on the screen when he is in bed and can sleep.
* Food now takes a little longer to be ready.
* Added internal light inside the refrigerator.
* Added a tutorial in Portuguese on the TV in the player's room.
* Removed a lateral movement of the Chevette camera.
* Removed the air brake sound on the machine and forklifts.
* Translation and some names in the menu have been improved.
* Reduced the possibility of rain.
* Added more drag to vehicles, they now tend to stop faster when you release the accelerator.
* The sun's intensity has been reduced and some changes have been made to the weather.
